wins: Cheap creatures attack early; every bit of life you gain grows Ajani's Pridemate, and burn finishes the job.
plan: Savannah Lions, Healer's Hawk, Ajani's Pridemate. Bolt a blocker if needed.
Inspiring Cleric gains 4 (a Pridemate counter), Glorious Anthem pumps the team, Raise the Alarm adds bodies.
Serra Angel in the air, Lightning Helix and Bolt to the face for the last points.
keys: A +1/+1 counter every time you gain life: Hawk, Cleric, Helix and Moment of Heroism all grow it.
+1/+1 to every creature: your small creatures become real threats.
3 damage and 3 life: removal or reach, and a Pridemate trigger.
+2/+2 and lifelink in combat: wins a fight and gains life.
tips: Gain life before combat when you can, so Pridemate attacks bigger.
Pacifism handles one big blocker for good.
Burn is flexible: early it clears blockers, late it goes to the opponent’s face.
mulligan: Keep 2–4 lands with at least two creatures that cost 1–2.
